stem: A client preparing for major elective surgery is referred to a prehabilitation program. Which plan best reflects the purpose of prehabilitation?

options.A: Begin individualized exercise and nutrition optimization before surgery, with other risk-reduction support such as smoking cessation or psychosocial preparation as indicated
options.B: Wait until a major postoperative functional decline occurs before starting exercise or nutrition interventions
options.C: Avoid activity before surgery so the client can conserve all physical capacity for the postoperative period
options.D: Use prehabilitation only as a substitute for postoperative rehabilitation and routine perioperative care

rationale: Prehabilitation aims to improve functional reserve before surgery. Programs may include exercise, nutrition optimization, psychological support, education and other modifiable-risk interventions. It complements rather than replaces routine perioperative and postoperative care.
educational_objective: Identify prehabilitation as proactive preoperative optimization of functional capacity and modifiable risks.
source_document_title: Prehabilitation; 2026 ACS exercise/nutrition prehabilitation evidence summary

source_claim_supported: Prehabilitation occurs before surgery and may include exercise, nutrition and other support to improve functional reserve.
